selection: Form every unordered pair of the sixteen published marked N14 continuations over exactly 1564 with distinct N14 end types. Orient the pair by increasing (end type, marked code). Preserve both one-event restrictions, add no order relation between the two new events and require transitive closure (commuting incomparable insertion diamond). Compute the minimum natural N15 code, require both published N14-to-N15 links and the published N15 ranks pure=free=mixed=0. Require an invertible chart integration block and mixed boundary block for the archived regular outer scalar pairing. Order candidates by number of missing A/B end types, then increasing (N15 natural end code, lower N14 end, upper N14 end, first marked code, second marked code). Primary is first. No clock response, target integral, score or physical weight enters selection.
supplement: Use the same order to select, if available, the first admissible candidate with determinant zero of the raw two-new-field Hessian block (genuine common Fourier constraints), and the first with a zero scalar pivot but invertible two-new-field block. Keep each distinct selected candidate once. If no such configuration is present, report the empty class.
scalar_check: On all selected cases compare the simultaneous two-field Abel/Fresnel pushforward with each integration order on all thirteen old scalar fields. For a degenerate block compare constraint subspace and delta normalization. Also compare determinant, inertia and exterior Schur kernel after a nondegenerate second pivot, or after distributional constraints have been explicitly substituted. Use inherited boundary chart and normalization.
clock_check: Compare the two iterated integrations and a direct double integration of the fixed fine N15 gravity/dust/clock amplitude on the five old inner times (-7/10,2/5,-1/10,23/20,-6/5) and densities (0,3/10,7/10,0,1/2), both inherited density centres for the past collar and both lobe centres. Use identical normalized Gauss grids 8 and 16 per added time and the inherited half-atom plus half-uniform density. Assess order-only at each grid with absolute tolerance 1e-12. These pointwise checks give no continuum accuracy or norm claim.
selector: Call a new local weight restriction only if a nonempty admissible positive set of coarse weights shrinks after existential elimination of ALL independent fine weights, with a common physical target/relative pairing supplied independently of weights, later observed bounds, registered clock PASS and detector. A branchwise integral identity by itself contributes zero information. Do not postulate equal branch weights or equal exterior amplitudes along distinct histories. Assess 1:1 and 1:3 under the actual equations. Separate local witnesses from proof of a simultaneous all-prefix fine marginal extension.
scope: Finite deterministic pilot. No RG, physical measure or P3 release criterion is inferred.
